native_interfaces.gateway_prefix_step:
gateway_prefix_step =
fun
  (previous : gateway_prefix_mode ->
              list nat -> option (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject * list nat))
  (mode : gateway_prefix_mode) (bytes : list nat) =>
match mode with
| gateway_prefix_value =>
    match bytes with
    | (0 :: rest)%list =>
        Some
          (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_value
             GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Value_null,
           rest)
    | (1 :: rest)%list =>
        Some
          (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_value
             (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Value_boolean GatewayImport.Bool_false),
           rest)
    | (2 :: rest)%list =>
        Some
          (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_value
             (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Value_boolean GatewayImport.Bool_true),
           rest)
    | (3 :: rest)%list => gateway_prefix_scalar 3 4 rest
    | (4 :: rest)%list => gateway_prefix_scalar 4 8 rest
    | (5 :: rest)%list => gateway_prefix_scalar 5 8 rest
    | (6 :: rest)%list => gateway_prefix_scalar 6 8 rest
    | (7 :: rest)%list =>
        let
        '(count, after) := gateway_prefix_word 4 rest in
         match previous (gateway_prefix_values count) after with
         | Some (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_values values, tail) =>
             Some
               (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_value
                  (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Value_array values),
                tail)
         | _ => None
         end
    | (8 :: rest)%list =>
        let
        '(count, after) := gateway_prefix_word 4 rest in
         match previous (gateway_prefix_fields count) after with
         | Some (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_fields fields, tail) =>
             Some
               (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_value
                  (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Value_object fields),
                tail)
         | _ => None
         end
    | (9 :: rest)%list => gateway_prefix_scalar 9 8 rest
    | _ => None
    end
| gateway_prefix_values 0 =>
    Some
      (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_values
         (GatewayImport.List_nil_inst1 GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Value),
       bytes)
| gateway_prefix_values (S count) =>
    match previous gateway_prefix_value bytes with
    | Some (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_value value, after) =>
        match previous (gateway_prefix_values count) after with
        | Some (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_values values, tail) =>
            Some
              (GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Subject_values
                 (GatewayImport.List_cons_inst1 GatewayImport.LeanCage_Host_GatewayResponseCode_Value value values),
               tail)
        | _ => None
        end
    | _ => None
    end
| gateway_prefix_fields 0 =>
